introHtml: Cuisinart folding chairs bring the trusted name in kitchen and outdoor gear to your seating needs. Whether you're outfitting a company picnic, a tailgate, or a trade show booth, these chairs offer durability and brand recognition. The aluminum frames keep them lightweight for easy transport, while the Cuisinart logo adds a touch of quality. Choose from multiple color options and add your logo via screen printing or embroidery for a polished look that stands out at any event.
